reason: A DeepSeek Harness plugin that statically checks pwsh tool calls for documented PowerShell pitfalls, optionally runs PSScriptAnalyzer, and provides corrective guidance before execution.

summaries.zh: 在 PowerShell 工具调用执行前检查常见语法与命令陷阱，并可通过内置规则或 PSScriptAnalyzer 提供阻止或警告信息。
summaries.en: Checks PowerShell tool calls for common syntax and command pitfalls before execution, with optional PSScriptAnalyzer support and deny-or-warn guidance.

capabilities: Intercepts PowerShell tool calls before execution
Statically checks PowerShell command text against bundled rules
Can deny or warn on detected PowerShell issues
Registers a powershell-check skill for session use
Optionally invokes PSScriptAnalyzer through a temporary PowerShell script
